settled_invariants: RiggingSurfaceIR remains immutable admitted substrate; QualifiedMeshIR is the single product geometry authority after G1-G5.
MechanicalPartitionIR may declare SEPARATE/PRESERVE_CONTINUITY/UNKNOWN but may not silently resolve consequential UNKNOWN at qualification.
QualifiedPresentationGraphIR owns slots/attachments/carriers/view overlays; runtime may not invent them.
No latest/current alias can substitute an exact artifact hash.
Downstream failure cannot erase verified upstream PASS.
Rest source preservation precedes motion authority.
Visible native motion is required before product closure.

known_context_traps.defense: Observation PIXEL_CENTER_XY is source texel index-centered while Runtime/G5 target centers are half-integer; the stage-31/32 regression locks this seam and forbids an extra 0.5 shift.

continuation_protocol.experiment_completion_definition: A stage closes only when its ledger row is PASS/CACHE_HIT, exact output hashes verify, and the next stage consumes those exact bindings. Stage 40 alone may close PRODUCT_PASS.
